title: Second order periodic boundary value problems with reflection and piecewise constant arguments
summary: In this paper, we analyze a second-order differential equation with a piecewise constant argument and reflection coupled to periodic boundary conditions. Our main contribution is the construction of the related Green's function and a detailed analysis of its properties. In particular, we determine the region in which the Green's function has constant sign, depending on the parameters $m$ and $M$ on which it depends.
